items.title: Disney (DIS) Faces A Fresh Box Office Test As Spider Man Nears Endgame
items.summary: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' opened to a record-setting domestic box office weekend, marking a major moment in Hollywood. The film is on track for the second-biggest domestic opening in history, directly referencing the benchmark set by Disney’s 'Avengers: Endgame'. This performance has put fresh attention on premium superhero franchises and how they stack up against Disney’s past box office records.
